title: ajax grandiflorus
intro: Ajax grandiflorus, commonly known as Ajax or Wild Indigo, is a flowering plant in the pea family that is native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Ajax grandiflorus include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs, as well as its potential to lower fever and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Ajax grandiflorus include isatin, berberine, and other alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
